jobs.title: Fullstack WebentwicklerIn
jobs.description:
About.


Unsere Arbeitsweise ist geprägt von hohem qualitativem Anspruch, Zuverlässigkeit und partnerschaftlichem Teamwork. Langfristige und erfolgreiche Kundenbeziehungen sind für uns das schönste Resultat. Inzwischen dürfen wir Kunden aus verschiedensten Sektoren der Wirtschaft, sowie öffentlichen Institutionen begrüßen.  

  

  



**We don't believe in No\-Win scenarios**
=========================================


Mit der Vereinigung von Know\-How aus verschiedenen Berufsdisziplinen, ist ein hochmotiviertes Team entstanden, das jederzeit in der Lage ist herausragende Lösungen für einzigartige Produkte und Settings zu erarbeiten.


  
Wir bieten unseren Kunden deutschlandweit Leistungen aus den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, Design, Consulting, Digitalisierung und IT\-Support an.


Mit viel Leidenschaft und Kreativität entwickeln und realisieren wir durchdachte Konzepte für nachhaltige On\- und Offlineprojekte. Wir wachsen ausschließlich organisch. Dabei steht die Qualität für unsere bestehenden Kunden immer im Vordergrund. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir im Team an jedem Projekt mit viel Herzblut für den Erfolg unserer Kunden.


  
Fullstack WebentwicklerIn
**Wir bieten:**
===============


* Ein spannendes und kreatives Arbeitsumfeld
* Hochinteressante / wechselnde Projekte und vielseitige Aufgabengebiete
* Projekte mit modernsten Web\-Technologien
* Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
* Förderung deiner persönlichen Stärken
* Ein angenehmes und freundschaftliches Arbeitsklima
* Sehr flache Hierarchien
* Gute Verkehrsanbindung
* Teilnahme an Community\-Events (Messen, Fortbildungen)
* Agile, kleine Entwicklungsteams
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Faire Vergütung
* Weiterbildungen und Veranstaltungen
  

**Was du mitbringen solltest:**
===============================


* Zwingend notwendig sind gute Kenntnisse in einer beliebigen Programmiersprache (JS, Java, C\+\+, Python C\#, etc.)
* Spaß an der Wegbereitung der Digitalisierung und der Entwicklung modernster Webanwendungen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript auf modernem Niveau
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Entwicklungsmethoden und \-prinzipien
* Erfahrung mit JavaScript\- und Python\-Frameworks (wie VueJS, React, Django)
* Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Git
* Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie die Entwicklung von Problemlösungsstrategien
* Teamfähigkeit
* Erste Praxiserfahrungen Quereinsteiger sind bei uns gerne gesehen
* Gute Selbstorganisation und hohe Eigenverantwortung
* Zuverlässigkeit und Sorgfalt
  

**Bewerbung:**
==============


Deine Softskills und das Verständnis für Informatik sind für uns die wichtigsten Faktoren, den Rest bekommen wir gemeinsam hin.


Wenn dein Profil zu dem beschriebenen Aufgabengebiet passt, freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inkl. Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Eintrittsdatum an:


**bewerbung@roba.one**

jobs.title: Security Installation Engineer
jobs.description:
SECOM Plc, part of the global SECOM Group, is a leader in fire and security solutions across 22 countries. With structured progression routes, award\-winning training, and a strong focus on employee wellbeing and sustainability, SECOM offers a stable, future\-focused career environment for skilled engineers.

**The role**  

Responsible for the installation of a range of fire and security systems including intruder alarms, access control and IP CCTV. You’ll ensure all systems are installed to design specifications and in line with client expectations, delivering high standards of workmanship, compliance, and safety.


Include installing systems to meet technical specifications, reading and interpreting plans and drawings, completing all digital documentation, ordering parts, collecting equipment, and providing site updates to project teams. You'll liaise closely with internal departments and clients, work to strict deadlines, and ensure a smooth transition during project handovers.

**The ideal candidate**  

Includes proven installation experience across all security systems, ideally with knowledge of Pyronix, IP CCTV and access control. A full UK driving licence is essential. You should be confident reading technical drawings, digitally literate, customer\-focused, and experienced in working to deadlines and compliance standards.

**Why apply?**

* Average Annual Earnings £50,000 \- £55,000 a year
* Paid door to door travel
* Company vehicle
* Private dental and health cover
* Life insurance
* Pension
* Cycle\-to\-work scheme
* Flexible working
* Access to 100s of discounts on hospitality, retail, entertainment via the SECOM Rewards Programme.
* Candidates will also benefit from extensive training and clear career progression paths through SECOM’s National Training Academy


SECOM Plc is a leading provider of customised security and fire solutions, and part of the global SECOM Group headquartered in Japan, operating across 22 countries. We are committed not only to protecting people and property, but also to supporting our employees with a strong benefits package, excellent career development opportunities, and access to the SECOM Rewards Programme, which offers exclusive discounts at over 900 UK retailers on groceries, travel, utilities, and more.


Our commitment extends beyond our people to the planet, with sustainability at the heart of our operations. We’ve earned a Gold rating from EcoVadis for our sustainable practices and are actively working towards achieving net\-zero emissions.


With a 4\.3 out of 5 rating on Glassdoor, SECOM is recognised for fostering a positive work environment where employees are valued and supported.

jobs.title: AI-Native Full Stack Developers
jobs.description:
**Company Description** QAT GPS (QAT GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEMS TRADING LLC) is a leading Middle Eastern provider of fleet management, IoT solutions, web development, and ecommerce services. The company designs, develops, supports, and promotes software and applications using integrated, state\-of\-the\-art technologies. QAT is a fast\-growing GPS monitoring solutions provider in the GCC region and maintains a strategic partnership with European leader Ruptela, whose products are used for fleet and personal tracking across six continents. The team brings strong expertise in communications technologies (GSM, 3G, 4G, GPS), electronics, and software systems, focusing on integrated solutions. QAT’s advanced MDVR and sensor integrations deliver comprehensive, real\-time fleet management capabilities, driver behavior analysis, and safety\-focused alerts.

**Role Description** : QAT is hiring **Mid\-Level Full Stack Developers** to join our team in Dubai.

We’re not looking for developers who only write code manually.

We’re looking for engineers who know how to work in the **new AI\-native development environment** — using AI agents, coding copilots, automation, modern frameworks, and rapid delivery workflows to build better products faster.

Dubai, UAE

Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Mid\-Level \| 3–5 Years Experience

2 Open Positions

How We Work

At QAT, developers are expected to use AI as part of their everyday engineering workflow.

You should be comfortable working with tools and approaches such as:

* Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents
* Agent\-assisted development and debugging
* AI\-driven code generation and refactoring
* Rapid prototyping and MVP development
* Automated testing and documentation
* API and system integration
* Modern CI/CD and deployment workflows
* Using AI to investigate bugs, understand codebases, and accelerate delivery

We care less about how many lines of code you write.

We care about how effectively you can **design, build, validate, and ship working solutions**.

What You’ll Build

You’ll work on real digital products, enterprise systems, integrations, automation platforms, and new technology initiatives.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Building modern web applications and internal platforms
* Designing frontend and backend architecture
* Creating APIs and integrating external systems
* Working with databases and cloud services
* Using AI agents to accelerate development and improve code quality
* Turning business requirements into working prototypes quickly
* Improving and modernizing existing systems
* Reviewing AI\-generated code and ensuring production quality
* Building automated tests and deployment pipelines
* Taking ownership from idea → development → deployment

What We’re Looking For

You should have strong fundamentals in software engineering and be comfortable using modern tools to move faster.

Ideally, you have experience with:

* React / Next.js / TypeScript
* Node.js, Python, .NET, PHP/Laravel, or similar backend technologies
* REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* SQL and/or NoSQL databases
* Git and modern development workflows
* Docker and containerized environments
* Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
* CI/CD pipelines
* AI APIs, LLMs, or AI\-agent integrations

The Mindset We Want

We’re looking for developers who think:

“Can this be automated?”

“Can an AI agent accelerate this?”

“Can we prototype this today instead of next week?”

“Can we simplify this architecture?”

“Can we ship a working version quickly and improve it continuously?”

You should be curious, independent, comfortable learning new technologies, and capable of taking ownership of a feature or project.

AI tools should make you **more productive — not replace your engineering judgment**.

Bonus Points

Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:

* AI agents and agentic workflows
* OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs
* RAG and vector databases
* MCP and AI tool integrations
* Workflow automation
* n8n / Make / Zapier
* Flutter or mobile development
* IoT platforms
* Analytics and dashboards
* DevOps / infrastructure automation

Who Should Apply

This role is ideal for developers who already use AI tools daily and want to work in an environment where experimentation, automation, and fast execution are encouraged.

Candidates based in the UAE are preferred.

Immediate or short\-notice availability is a plus.

How to Apply

Please send your application to birame@qat\-gps.com and include:

* CV / LinkedIn profile
* GitHub or portfolio
* Current location
* Notice period
* Expected salary
* The AI development tools you currently use

Pay: From AED5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer
jobs.description:
W firmie ABB
pomagamy przedsiębiorstwom działać sprawniej i czyściej – i każdy człowiek w naszej firmie się do tego przyczynia. Będziesz mieć możliwość przewodzenia, otrzymasz wsparcie w rozwoju i poczujesz dumę z wpływu, jaki wspólnie wywieramy. Dołącz do nas i pomóż zarządzać tym, co napędza świat.

Stanowisko To Podlega

Innovation Enablement Manager

__

As a Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer you will be a member of a team developing and maintaining sales configurators solutions supporting the operations and customers of ABB Electrification (EL) - Distribution Solution (ELDS) and Service (ELSE). You will be working in a cross-functional team which operates in an international environment.

In this role you will be responsible for the modelling and maintenance of distribution systems and service products (switchgears, grid components and service offering ) in the new global ELDS/SE sales configurator platform(s). You will closely collaborate with product sales configurators, portfolio managers and engineers to design, implement, test and troubleshoot the product models. Together with the internal ABB IS and Business Teams you will have unique opportunity to learn the product portfolio and based on that design and deliver the future platform ensuring it meets the needs of our customers and sales team

The work model for the role is: #hybrid;

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For

Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot product models for ELDS and ELSE.
Develop the product models as defined by the Product Managers / Sales Configurators Portfolio Managers and Engineers. Ensure product models are well-structured to enable high quality change management and simplify the future maintenance
Collaborate with relevant IS and Business stakeholders to deliver a user-friendly and efficient Sales Configurator solution.
Work closely with the platform supplier / implementation partner to ensure the integrity of the product model is guaranteed as the platform evolves.
Provide technical support, troubleshooting and fixing issues reported by users.
Contribute to the overall sales configurator development process

Qualifications For The Role

You are highly skilled in product modelling and configuration within sales configurator tools and enjoy working in the industrial technology and engineering sector
You have established experience in the software development lifecycle, including working with tools such as Azure DevOps
You possess solid expertise in programming languages such as .NET, Python, Java, or similar technologies
You are highly adept in configurator platforms, with experience in Configit ACE considered an advantage
You are passionate about teamwork and collaboration, while also demonstrating a proactive, solution-oriented, and independent working style
You are resilient in agile, fast-paced environments and are motivated by continuous learning and development
You have proven experience or a strong understanding of industrial product portfolios; knowledge of ABB’s DS and SE Division portfolio is considered a plus

Aby zbudować czystszą, mądrzejszą przyszłość, potrzebne są różne umysły: ciekawe, odważne i kreatywne. Dlatego witamy ludzi z każdego środowiska i o różnych doświadczeniach.

Chcesz wywrzeć wpływ?

Aplikuj już dzisiaj lub odwiedź stronę https://www.abb.com
, aby dowiedzieć się więcej o wpływie naszych rozwiązań na całym świecie.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Du som gillar att röra dig över hela stacken och som brinner för utveckling, det här är för dig!

Magello jobbar tillsammans med våra kunder för att lösa deras verkliga problem. Vårt fokus är hållbar digital utveckling, med tyngdpunkt inom  AI, cloud, teknisk förändring,  integration och digitala tjänster.  Vi arbetar med några av Sveriges mest kända och viktigaste varumärken och myndigheter.

Vad kommer du göra?

Vi är konsulter, vilket innebär att våra arbetsuppgifter ser lite olika ut. Vi har utmanande uppdrag inom flera branscher, både inom privat och offentlig sektor. Som fullstackutvecklare hos oss är du en del av ett utvecklingsteam med fokus att förstå och lösa kundens utmaningar utifrån deras faktiska behov.

Att lösa problem och att bygga hållbara digitala tjänster är det vi gör bäst på Magello. Oavsett om du är ute hos kund eller jobbar inhouse kommer du att få stöd från oss andra. Du kommer att rapportera till och arbeta nära en av våra konsultchefer. Du kommer också att ha ett internt team av konsulter som blir din bas hos Magello.

För oss är digitala tjänster ett annat ord för produkter, verktyg och lösningar som används i en teknisk värld. Exempel på platser där du som fullstackutvecklare skulle kunna hjälpa till att lösa problem är Skatteverket, Pricer, ICA och Scania.

Vem söker vi?

Vi förstår att du tickar vissa av dessa boxar mer än andra och därmed håller vi alltid ett öppet sinne i vår rekrytering. Men för att lyckas väl i rollen tror vi att du har några av följande kompetenser:

Minst sex års erfarenhet inom systemutveckling.
Ett tekniskt modersmål i Java eller .NET
Din tekniska tyngd inom backend
Erfarenhet av JavaScript/TypeScript ramverk, som Angular, React eller Vue
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med molnplattform som Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure eller Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD
Erfarenhet eller intresse av att använda AI som verktyg inom yrket
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med agila metodiker i systemutveckling som Kanban eller Scrum

Vi anställer fullstackutvecklare löpande så skicka in din ansökan om du tycker att Magello låter intressant. Om vi tror att du skulle kunna passa hos oss, tar vi ett möte. Vi lägger lika stor vikt vid din personlighet som din tekniska kompetens. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
